title: Hold a pick gently
summary: A small grip, with a little tip showing.

steps.title: Hold a pick gently
steps.body:
**pick** means a small flat piece you hold to brush a string

**Why it matters:** It gives you another way to start a clear sound.

Hold it gently between the side of your index finger and your thumb. Leave only a small tip showing. Keep your wrist loose. You can use a fingertip instead; a pick is optional.

steps.title: Look and listen
steps.body: Keep the pick near the strings, with a little tip visible. Try moving it through the air once, without hitting anything.

items.prompt: How should you hold a guitar pick?
choices: gently, with a small tip showing
squeeze hard, with the whole pick showing
items.answer: gently, with a small tip showing

steps.title: Take your time
steps.body: Try a light grip, then relax it. Your arm and wrist should not tense up. No pick? Use a fingertip later.

items.prompt: How should you hold a guitar pick?
